title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Amendment Act 2012

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Amendment Act 2012
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2013
ACT I OF 2013
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA STANDARD WEIGHTS
AND MEASURES ENFORCEMENT (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2012
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Standard
Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1976
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary
9th January, 2012
No.PA/Khyber Pkthunkhwa/Bills/2013/754, dated 9-1-2013.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement (Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
on 21st December, 2012 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 7th January, 2013 is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act,
1976, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Standard Weights and
Measures Enforcement (Amendment) Act, 2012.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment
of section 26 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. III
of 1976.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1976, (Act No. III of 1976),
hereinafter referred to the said Act, in section 26,--
(a) in subsection (1), for the word "two", the word
"twenty" shall be substituted; and
(b) in subsection (2), for the words "one thousand and five
hundred rupees", the words "twenty thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"45A.
Act to override other laws.---The provisions of this
Act shall have an overriding effect notwithstanding anything to the contrary
contained in any other law for the time being in force.".
